body: Was the removal of this `EditorNode` check intentional?

Yes, the first one is replaced with an early returns without throwing errors because it was never meant to be called when running the scenes from editor, and also the `EditorNode::get_singleton()` will never be triggered after that, will wait until reviewing the code and checking if any of those checks are still needed.
Unless this is guaranteed to be non-null it's still needed so I'd leave it in, as it's used below

Given that this was added specifically to solve a bug I think there's no reason to assume this is unnecessary, unless that condition has been fixed elsewhere:
* https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/99846

Ok will revert back this change, just have a question because i have seen some parts of code favors `EditorNode::get_singleton()` over `Engine::get_singleton()->is_editor_hint()`, Can `EditorNode::get_singleton()` return null even when `Engine::get_singleton()->is_editor_hint()` returns true, and vice versa?

This case shows that it can, not sure why it can but it can since this check was added because `Engine::get_singleton()->is_editor_hint()` was not enough, not sure when and if the singleton is created, it might be a problem of deferred calls or similar

Though I think a proper solution would be what Akien suggests here:
* https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/99846#issuecomment-2511440560

That in import mode previews are not generated at all, but might be good to wait again with fixing that part, unless there's an easy way to detect `--import` mode entirely

One check could be `EditorNode::is_cmdline_tool`, which includes `--import` and `--export-*`

Thanks for showing the actual PR that have added the check, since git blame failed because the change was a result of reverting a PR where it deletes the whole method and it wasn't ignored, yes i agree that the editor preview shouldn't be part of the cmd `--import` process and I will wait until we find a better fix for this issue or we use this as a workaround if it wasn't fixed before the 4.5 release.
